currentRoundInspection.method: Two aerial photographs inspected in browser; current standard viewer PMTiles/DEM control fit. No bespoke survey research and no redistributed photographs.

pictures.observations: West/south aerial: dominant eight-sided terracotta dome with pale ribs and lantern, square separate campanile with increasing paired/triple pointed windows, cream/green/pink marble panel rhythm, high red nave roof, three polygonal east/north/south tribunes and four small rounded buttress bodies. West front has three portals, large central rose, two smaller roses, pinnacles and stepped triangular gables. Baptistery is a separate building and excluded.

Elevated west/south view confirms broad white ribs, eight drum oculi, tall open lantern, gold crown/ball and cross, red nave roof behind stepped front, campanile paired lower and triple upper pointed belfry panes, tall cornice and open upper parapet. Green marble outlines cream panels with restrained pink insets; no photographic facade texture is used.
